{{Actor|name=ovl_Bg_Dy_Yoseizo}}

'''ovl_Bg_Dy_Yoseizo''' is the [[Great Fairy]] [[Actor]].

[[Category:Great Fairy]]
== General Notes ==

There are six different encounters with the Great Fairy actor. Rather than use a different variable for each one, the "version" of the Great Fairy is hardcoded, using the [[scene]] number (59 for upgrades, 61 for spells) combined with the [[Entrance Table|entrance]] (specifically the "entrance" number defined by the entrance table) used to enter the scene.

{|class="wikitable"
! Scene || Entrance # || Reward
|-
| 59 || 00 || Magic / Spin Attack
|-
| 59 || 01 || Double Magic
|-
| 59 || 02 || Double Defense 
|-
| 59 || 03 || ???
|-
| 61 || 00 || Farore's Wind
|-
| 61 || 01 || Din's Fire
|-
| 61 || 02 || Nayru's Love
|}

Additionally, the player must obtain Magic / Spin Attack first to be able to encounter the other Great Fairies.

{{clear}}
